name: Матовий майстер: остання горизонталь
description:
You already know what a back-rank mate is. Once again, you are going to trap your opponent’s king on the back rank. This time, you need to beat a defender to do so.

You have learned three ways to get rid of a defender: capturing, deflecting (chasing away) and luring away. You need to use all of these tricks in this lesson.

The examples show how this is done.

 

What do you have to do?

Checkmate the king on the back rank by beating a defender. This may take you three or four moves, so keep calculating!

examples.text:
The knight defends the mate square.
White captures the knight.
If Black takes back, White will mate. 
If Black does not recapture, White wins 3 points.

Again, the knight protects the mate square.
This time, White can get rid of the knight by having the pawn attack it (a deflection).

If Black moves his knight, White will checkmate.
If Black leaves the knight on its spot, White wins points.

This time, the knight not only defends the mate square but another knight as well.
That is one job too much.
 
White can lure away the protecting knight by taking the (green) knight.
If Black recaptures, White will deliver mate.

If Black does not recapture, White gains 3 points!
